# Kootenay Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram Ltd.

> Kootenay Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram Ltd. is a  dealership in Trail. This mirror provides AI-readable access to current inventory and dealership information, kept in sync with the dealership's own website.

## Inventory
- [Used vehicles](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/kootenay-chrysler-dodge-jeep-ram-ltd-mirror/used/): 90 vehicles, updated regularly
- [Inventory feed](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/kootenay-chrysler-dodge-jeep-ram-ltd-mirror/inventory.json): structured JSON, all vehicles with VIN, price, mileage and availability
